accepted_scope: For each frozen reconstructed Stage-E actor, when the real block-declaration menu has one legal DeclareBlockers action, validBlockers is exactly empty and mandatory blocker assignments are null or empty, the whole actor may propose DeclareBlockers(actor, emptyMap()).
The real engine accepts that exact proposal.
Previously accepted forced-empty attackers, unique-pass priority and bounded multi-cast discriminator seams remain clean.
limits: No blocker selection when a valid blocker exists.
No mandatory blocker assignment, blocker ordering or combat-damage assignment.
No nonempty attacker ranking or broader pass-vs-cast authority.
No trusted runner/replay, Stage-E freeze/admission, seed, allocation or gameplay authority.
next_gate: Advance the smallest remaining nonempty combat/action-selection surface or trusted runner/replay boundary without broadening the accepted multi-cast/pass limits.
